value.rationale: Invertibility and numerical stability of structured finite convolution filters are natural exact harmonic-analysis invariants. The inverse-pencil construction produces a uniform three-chirp family for all odd primes and all dimensions, the complete singular-value multiset, a sharp uniform prime-three minimum rank with all equality cases and an explicit rank-one model, and a dimension-independent sharp condition number when p>=5 and rank(V)>=2. These jointly identify an exact characteristic-dependent loss-of-information mechanism not furnished by the classical individual-chirp results. Restriction to the motivated inverse-pencil family is essential and explicit.
